title: Searching for P-Adic Log-Periodic Signatures in the Cosmic Microwave Background Bispectrum: Upper Bounds from Planck 2018

metadata_sent.title: Searching for P-Adic Log-Periodic Signatures in the Cosmic Microwave Background Bispectrum: Upper Bounds from Planck 2018
metadata_sent.description: We search for p-adic (ultrametric) log-periodic signatures in the cosmic microwave background bispectrum. Discrete scale invariance under integer rescalings predicts radix-locked oscillations with angular frequency omega_p = 2*pi/ln(p), p in {2,3,5,7}. We construct the p-adic bispectrum template, compute its shape-space orthogonality against the resonant-feature family, and derive upper bounds from the public Planck 2018 non-Gaussianity constraints: epsilon_p < 2.5 at 95% CL for every radix, with no detection in the probed frequency range. Within a single-modulation model this bound is approximately 830 times weaker than the two-point bound (A_LPO < 3e-3); the higher-order channel does not amplify the p-adic signal. Radix identifiability is partial: p=2 is orthogonal to all other small primes, while (3,5) and (5,7) pairs are degenerate at Planck resolution. Pre-registered at OSF (2ndsz).
